'''Leezoth's Antiquities and Fine Imports''' was a business located in the [[Modern District]] of [[Ord Mynock Freeport]]. Run by [[Leezoth]], the business advertised that it dealt with rare objects and art, but the general perception of the store's contents was that it was filled with junk. [[Lunk]], a large [[Alien/Legends|alien]], was hired by Leezoth to guard the store.<ref name="Game" />
